name: dev-workflow-standard
description: Engineering harness: diagnose demands, apply complexity-proportional intent contracts, invoke specialist skills/executors, capture execution receipts after observable results, validate evidence, recover or replan, and review delivery.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate engineering execution, not just task planning.
interface.longDescription: Dev Workflow Standard acts as an engineering harness for software delivery: diagnose and scope the demand, select a TRIVIAL, NORMAL, or COMPLEX intent contract, resolve the required specialist skill/plugin/tool or executor, verify runtime availability, actively invoke the selected capability, preserve handoff context, capture an EXECUTION_RECEIPT from observable results, validate evidence before advancing, recover or replan on failure, and review delivery against its acceptance criteria. Product code remains the responsibility of dev-implementation-standard or another explicitly approved executor capability as a local architectural decision.
defaultPrompt: Use Dev Workflow Standard as the engineering harness for this demand.
Resolve and invoke the capabilities required to execute this approved task.
Continue this engineering workflow from the current execution state and evidence.
Review this result against the task, specs, execution receipt and acceptance criteria.
